findings.claim: Only the four evidence artifacts are LF-pinned; the two new non-evidence paths named by completion criterion 9 (the new TypeScript core and its test) carry no line-ending attribute, so their bytes are not identical in a Windows core.autocrlf=true checkout.
findings.reproduction: git check-attr text eol -- lib/promptRefinerShadowAdmissionCore.ts tests/promptRefinerShadowAdmissionCore.test.mjs → both report "text: unspecified" and "eol: unspecified", whereas the same command on docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow/evidence/admission-readiness-v1.manifest.json reports "text: set", "eol: lf". No digest depends on either new path (neither is in PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_SOURCE_PATHS, lib/promptRefinerShadowSource.ts:11-25), and the repo pins only digest-bound paths, so this is a criterion-vs-convention decision for the author rather than a functional break.

findings.claim: The returned proposal is a plain mutable object — only PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_STAGE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS is frozen — so the "immutable proposal" property holds at the TypeScript literal-type level but not at runtime for a JS caller.

findings.claim: The commit that freezes the bundle also edits .gitattributes, which is a member of the bundle's own source allowlist, so the evidence can never be regenerated from this branch — the disclosure is correct, but the bundle is now verify-only rather than reproducible.
findings.reproduction: The report pins .gitattributes → 2638c45e7dcb13e22deb22492f0aa9ad3152c82179b89e2e57ed05819aed843e (the f1e1b0c2 bytes). scripts/prompt-refiner-shadow-harness.mjs:140-148 builds `anchored` from `git show <sourceRef>:path` and `current` from the worktree, and lib/promptRefinerShadowSource.ts:84-89 fails `runtime_source_drift` on any inequality; since HEAD adds 10 lines to .gitattributes, re-running the harness with --source-ref f1e1b0c23fd93cfa9dbaa0a68abe603d989c3830 at HEAD fails source-drift instead of reproducing the four files. Nothing to change in this round — docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow/evidence/README.md:16-20, docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow-harness.md §8 and docs/policy/prompt-refiner-observability.md §10 already state the snapshot-only limitation, and the verifier hard-codes currentCheckoutValidated=false / runtimeSourceRevalidationRequired=true.
